objective: Identify General George Glasgow’s own father from a parent-naming original, without repeating completed source tests.

research_state.last_test: Own father remains Unknown. The earlier Royal Artillery George Glasgow is a plausible relative, not a selected father: Askwith’s 1900 officer list, printed p.11, officer no.394, records his death at Charlton on 16 March 1785. The later general is a separate officer, no.498 on printed p.14, admitted as cadet in 1771 and dying in 1820. Both table pages were visually checked. Shared surname, corps and Charlton association do not distinguish father from another relative or namesake. The unsourced member-tree father George (1725–1785) is only a lead; neither that birth year nor parentage is independently established. The Sandhurst Collection’s own RMA register description says its earliest surviving volume begins in 1783, with retrospective and incomplete early entries; it cannot provide a normal 1771 admission entry. The 1892 Records of the Royal Military Academy introduction says the intended complete cadet list was omitted; the introduction was visually checked. A bounded OCR surname check is not proof of absence from every page. Discovery’s exact-name George Glasgow search for 1785–1786 returned no catalogue result; the unrestricted exact-name search exposed only the already-read 1820 will in the PROB collection facet. This does not establish intestacy or rule out variant spellings or local probate jurisdictions.
research_state.next_test: Seek a parent-naming baptism for the general around 1755–1757 at Woolwich/Charlton, or an original Royal Artillery officer service return giving birth, origin or family. Test an actual Charlton/Rochester probate or administration entry for the earlier officer if located. Do not repeat the 1820 will, purchase the 1892 academy book expecting a complete cadet list, or search the 1783-onward cadet register as though it covers 1771. Any proposed father must also resolve the earlier officer’s identity against retained Scottish George candidates.
